title: A Policy-Driven Runtime Layer for Agentic LLM Serving
authors: Rui Zhang; Chaeeun Kim; Liting Hu
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Cross-cutting policies in multi-agent LLM serving (prefix caching, batch shaping, fairness, etc.) need both agent identity from the framework and engine-level events, but neither layer holds both, so each policy today is a one-off patch into one neighbor. For KV caching specifically, recurring agent anchors (0.34 to 0.52 of every first-turn prompt) drop out of reactive LRU prefix caches before the next session arrives.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM serving 中的跨層政策（prefix caching、batch shaping、公平性等）同時需要框架端的 agent 身分與引擎端的事件，但兩層各自只掌握一半，導致每項政策目前都以一次性補丁塞進其中一側。就 KV caching 而言，跨 session 重複出現的 agent anchor（佔每個首輪 prompt 的 0.34 至 0.52）在下一個 session 到來前，就已被 reactive 的 LRU prefix cache 淘汰。

key_innovation.en: An agent runtime layer: a third tier between agent framework and serving engine exposing four primitives (observe, score, predict, act) with agent identity as the shared coordinate. Instantiated as CacheSage for KV caching: an online first-order Markov agent-transition learner, survival-probability-based eviction scoring, and cross-session prefetch of the predicted next agent's anchor, with <=20 KB state per workload and graceful fallback to LRU.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 agent runtime layer：位於 agent 框架與 serving engine 之間的第三層，以 agent 身分為共享座標，對外提供四個 primitive（observe、score、predict、act）。並以 CacheSage 實例化於 KV caching：線上學習一階 Markov agent 轉移矩陣、以存活機率作為 eviction 評分，並對預測的下一個 agent 之 anchor 進行跨 session prefetch；每個 workload 的狀態 <=20 KB，且可平滑退化為 LRU。

key_improvements.en: +13 to +37 pp KV cache hit-rate lift, 12% to 29% lower mean TTFT, and 6% to 14% higher throughput over an unmodified serving stack across five real multi-agent workloads.
key_improvements.zh: 在五個真實多 agent 工作負載上，相較未修改的 serving stack，KV cache 命中率提升 +13 至 +37 個百分點，平均 TTFT 降低 12% 至 29%，吞吐量提升 6% 至 14%。

infra_layer: KV-cache reuse, Serving / scheduling, Control plane / interface

workloads_traces.en: AutoGen SelectorGroupChat with a six-agent supervisor on MMLU, MT-Bench, GAIA, and GSM8K, plus a synthetic 12-agent chain; 50 tasks and 948-1,417 turns per workload.
workloads_traces.zh: AutoGen SelectorGroupChat 的 six-agent supervisor，工作負載為 MMLU、MT-Bench、GAIA 與 GSM8K，另含 synthetic 12-agent chain；每個 workload 為 50 tasks、948–1,417 turns。

key_parameters.en: 1x H100 80 GB; real workloads concurrency 4 with 120-block cache, synthetic concurrency 1 with 250 blocks; first-turn shareable fractions .52/.34/.34/.36/.34 in characterization; fingerprint skip=4, take=4; first-order online Markov predictor; retain edge when P(b|a)>=tau with tau=.01; w_pred=1.0; prefetch uses system prompt, a one-character user message, and exactly one generated token. Block size, sliding-window length, horizon, token lengths, QPS, tool delays, and repeats not stated.
key_parameters.zh: 1x H100 80 GB；real workload 併發 4、cache 120 blocks，synthetic 併發 1、cache 250 blocks；characterization 的 first-turn shareable fraction 為 .52/.34/.34/.36/.34；fingerprint skip=4、take=4；first-order online Markov predictor；當 P(b|a)>=tau 且 tau=.01 時保留 edge；w_pred=1.0；prefetch 使用 system prompt、單一字元 user message 與恰一個 generated token。block size、sliding-window length、horizon、token 長度、QPS、工具延遲與重複次數未載明。

metrics_defined.en: Hit rate is cached_tokens/prompt_tokens; evaluation reports per-turn E2E latency and turns/s, while the abstract labels a 12-29% number as mean TTFT without a plotted TTFT definition.
metrics_defined.zh: Hit rate 為 cached_tokens/prompt_tokens；評測回報 per-turn E2E latency 與 turns/s，而摘要將 12–29% 數字稱為 mean TTFT，卻未提供相應圖表定義。

headline_vs_realistic.en: The abstract headline is +13-37 pp cache hit, 12-29% lower mean TTFT, and 6-14% higher throughput; the evaluation itself reports 6-26% lower per-turn E2E latency rather than a defined TTFT.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: 摘要 headline 為 cache hit +13–37 個百分點、mean TTFT 降低 12–29%、throughput 提升 6–14%；但評測實際回報的是 per-turn E2E latency 降低 6–26%，並未定義 TTFT。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: CacheSage assumes recent per-workload agent transitions predict the next agent; per-query topology shifts are handled only after new transitions enter call history.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: CacheSage 假設近期 per-workload agent transition 可預測下一個 agent；逐 query 拓撲變動只能在新 transition 進入 call history 後才被處理。
